title: Качество данных
semantics: Profile continuous integer/real and discrete string fields with native Quality defaults and parameters:{}. Read all five outputs: 0 OutData, 1 OutDataOut, 2 OutDataExtr, 3 OutDataNull, 4 SummaryTable. Native default ports 0/3 preserve the input; 1/2 can be empty despite positive summary counts. Summary N, DisplayName, DataType, DataKind, Null, Out, Extr, Avg, Moda, Median follows input field order. Median is the upper middle observation; continuous Moda is a histogram bin center, discrete Moda a frequency mode. NULL differs from empty string. No correction thresholds, hidden action settings, training or saved-model apply mode. Exact Moda subtype/value is read through the bounded native decoder. PROPOSAL SCOPE ONLY: boolean/datetime and discrete numeric inputs, hidden MaxNullsPercent/actions and saved-model apply require live discovery. No additional mode or hidden-settings schema is proposed without observing its UI. This card estimates profile metadata size only, not the complete future extension.

parameter_schema.description: profile requires {}. Native default settings only; no thresholds, correction actions, training or saved-model apply parameters. Continuous integer/real and discrete string input fields. Read outputs 0,1,2,3,4.
